spans.s:
mn. (-नः-नं)
A day.
E.
दी to waste, नक् affix, and the vowel made short; or दो to destroy, (darkness,) किनन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Poor, indigent, needy, distressed.
2 Afraid, frightened, timid.
f. (-ना)
A mouse or shrew.
E.
दी to waste or decay, affix क्त, deriv. irr. or दी as before, Uṇādi affix नक्.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
दिन day, and कर who makes.

f. (-जा)
The Yamunā or Jumna river.
E.
दिनकर the sun, and आत्मजा daughter.

m. (-कृत्)
The sun.
E.
दिन, and कृत् who makes.

m. (-वः)
Darkness.
E.
दिन day, and केशब hair.

n. (-तिः)
Sunshine, day-light.
E.
दिन day, and ज्योतिस् light.

m. (-तः)
The ruddy goose.
E.
दिन day, and दुःखित pained; regretting throughout the day, the approaching nocturnal separation from its female.

m. (-णीः)
The sun.
E.
दिन day, and प्रणी leading, bringing.

m. (-लः)
A name of certain signs of the zodiac, the fifth to the eighth; also the eleventh and twelfth.
E.
दिन, and बल strong.

m. (-णिः)
The sun.
E.
दिन day, and मणि jewel or gem.

m. (-र्द्धा)
The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to rise.
E.
दिन day, and मूर्द्धन् the forehead.

m. (-शः)
A portion of the day, a watch, an hour, or the three seasons of dawn, noon, and evening.
E.
दिन, and अंश part or portion.

m. (-दिः)
Dawn, day-break.
E.
दिन, and आदि commencement.

m. (-न्तः)
Evening, sun-set, close of day.
E.
दिन day, and अन्त end.

m. (-कः)
Darkness.
E.
दिन day, and अन्तक ender.

m. (-म्भः)
Morning.
E.
दिन, and आरम्भ beginning.

n. (-नं)
Evening, close of day.
E.
दिन day, and अवसान expiration.

f. (-का)
A day's wages, hire for a day or by the day.
E.
दिन a day, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Distressed, dejected.
E.
दीन, and चेतन feeling.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
Down-cast, of melancholy aspect.
E.
दीन, and मुख mouth.

m. (-रः)
1 A gold ornament.
2 A seal.
3 A weight of gold, variously stated as two Kāṣṭhas, one Pala of thirtytwo Reitis, and also as the large Pala or hundred and eight

Suvarṇas.
4

A coin, a Dinar.
E.
दीन a pauper, and ऋ to go; what is given to the poor; or दी to waste, Uṇādi affix आरन्, and नुट् augment.
